Animal Reproduction Equipment and Systems Sectional Committee, FADC 41 



FOREWORD 

This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the 
Animal Reproduction Equipment and Systems Sectional Committee had been approved by the Food 
and Agriculture Division Council. 

Freezing of semen has now become common and requires various equipments to handle it. The 
straw holding clips are meant to hold a number of straws in position while being filled with semen. 
This standard is, therefore, being evolved to ensure production of quality straw clips. 

For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the 
final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in 
accordance with IS 2 : 1960 'Rules for rounding off numerical values (revised)'. The number of 
significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value 
in this standard. 



IS 13033 : 1990 



Indian Standard 
STRAW HOLDING CLIPS - SPECIFICATION 



1 SCOPE 

1.1 This standard prescribes the material, dimen- 
sions and other requirements for straw holding 
clips. 

2 REFERENCES 

2.1 The following Indian Standards are necessary 
adjuncts to this standard; 



IS No. 

6527 : 1972 
6911 : 1972 



3 TYPES 



Title 

Stainless steel wire rod 

Stainless steel plate, sheet and 

strip 



3.1 For the purpose of this standard, the straw 
holding clips shall be of the following two types 
namely: 

Type I Medium 
Type II Mini 

4 MATERIALS 

4.1 The material for various components of the 
clips shall be as under: 

a) Clips — Stainless steel sheet ( see IS 691 1 : 
1972 ) of 0*6 mm thickness. 

b) Needle hinge and locking rod — Stainless 
steel wire ( see IS 6527 : 1972 ) of l'O mm 
diameter. 

c) Padding — Rubber. 

5 DIMENSIONS 

5.1 The hinge as well as the lock shall be such 



that the locked straw holding clip shall have a 
clearance of 2*4 mm for Type I and 2*0 mm for 
Type II clips. 

5.2 The unfolded rubber padding shall be 
1 10 mm in length and 25 mm in width. The thick- 
ness of the rubber padding shall be such that the 
clearance required for the straw holding clips is 
maintained. 

6 MANUFACTURE AND FINISH 

6.1 Straw holding clips shall be formed by folded 
rubber padding supported by two stainless steel 
sheets which shall be connected by a needle hinge. 
The inner side of the rubber pad shall be longitu- 
dinally corrugated for grip. The needle hinge 
shall permit opening of the straw holding clips 
easily to above 60°. There shall be an easy lock- 
ing arrangement between the metal plates. 

6.2 The straw holding clips shall be evenly and 
smoothly finished with ends rounded off. The 
rubber used should withstand frequent washing 
and sterilization with alcohol. 

7 PACKING 

7.1 The straw holding clips shall be packed as 
agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 

8 MARKING 

8,1 Each straw holding clip shall be marked with 
the following information ; 

a) Name of the material, 

b) Indication of the source of manufacture, 

c) Type, and 

d) Batch or code number. 



Standard Mark 

The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards 
Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations ma<k thereunder. The Standard Mark on products 
eovered by an Indian Standard conveys the assutance that they have been produced to comply with 
the requirements of that standard under a well defined system of inspection, testing and quality 
control which is devised and supervised by BIS and operated by the producer. Standard marked 
products are also continuously checked by BIS for conformity to that standard as a further safe- 
guard. Details of conditions under which a 1 icence for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted to 
manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards.

harmonious development of the activities of standardization, marking and quality certification of 
goods and attending to connected matters in the country.
